acceptance_criteria: Generator reuse is conditional on code availability and a verified compatible license; otherwise an independently implemented paper-derived generator is required.
Isaac generation, common geometry export, raw LiDAR storage, B1/M1 training, topology construction, and M-TARE integration have explicit interfaces and validation gates.
The formal data capacity is revised to a staged learning curve up to 100 development worlds and 500000 observations without using M-TARE benchmark worlds.
The first topology builder and graph planner are deterministic and separately evaluated from learned perception.
The publication plan states that combining prior systems is insufficient and defines evidence required for RA-L/JFR/T-RO-level claims.
No data generation, simulation, annotation, or training occurs and Gate 0 remains GATE_MIXED.
